---
title: "Blog"
subtitle: "Notes on academic life, computational science, and research."
page-layout: full
toc: false
sidebar: false
body-classes: blog-index
listing:
  - id: posts-grid
    contents: posts
    sort: "date desc"
    template: _post-grid.ejs
    date-format: "M/D/YY"
    fields: [image, date, title, description, categories]
    feed:
      title: "Joseph Frimpong's Blog"
      description: "Thoughts on academic life, computational materials science, and research"
      categories: [academia, tutorial, research]
  - id: posts-list
    contents: posts
    sort: "date desc"
    type: default
    categories: true
    sort-ui: true
    filter-ui: true
    image-height: 180px
    fields: [image, date, title, reading-time, description, categories]
---

```{=html}
<div class="view-toggle" role="group" aria-label="Blog layout">
  <button type="button" data-view="grid" aria-pressed="true">Grid</button>
  <button type="button" data-view="list" aria-pressed="false">List</button>
</div>
```

::: {#posts-grid data-blog-view="grid"}
:::

::: {#posts-list data-blog-view="list" hidden="hidden"}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
  // Grid | List toggle; the choice is remembered per visitor.
  (function () {
    var KEY = 'blog-view';
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.view-toggle button');
    function show(view) {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-blog-view]').forEach(function (el) {
        el.hidden = el.getAttribute('data-blog-view') !== view;
      });
      buttons.forEach(function (b) {
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.view === view));
      });
      document.body.classList.toggle('blog-view-grid', view === 'grid');
      document.body.classList.toggle('blog-view-list', view === 'list');
    }
    var saved = null;
    try { saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) {}
    show(saved === 'list' ? 'list' : 'grid');
    buttons.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        show(b.dataset.view);
        try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, b.dataset.view); } catch (e) {}
      });
    });
  })();
</script>
```
